description: A single hardcoded literal LOOKS fast, but install.sh is on the fixed sensitive-path list, so Step 2(c) forces full. This is the case where a cheap-tier heuristic would be wrong.
prompt: Bump the VERSION variable in install.sh from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1.
_note: maxTurns=6 deliberately: measured 2026-08-24, maxTurns=2 starved two cases into a FALSE failure (the tier was never stated because the run was cut off, not because Triage misfired). A too-tight turn budget manufactures defects that do not exist.
